items.q: I remember that the film that was showing at the Palace during the week was 'What price Hollywood' starring Constance Bennett.

ctx.x: The first hop was Chicago and following is a critic that ran in one of the local papers: 'Ralph Cooper and Band hit. Ralph Cooper brought his famous band into Chicago last week for an engagement at the Palace Theater and scored an instant hit. The opening of the show found the theater packed and they drew well throughout the engagement. Ralph had assembled some of New York's best musicians and whipped them into a selling outfit. Cooper directs the band, sings a number or two and does a dance number that equals…
I remember that the film that was showing at the Palace during the week was 'What price Hollywood' starring Constance Bennett.
The musicians other than McClung, Goodwin, Horton, Burnett and myself were Arnold 'Scrip' Boling, ex- Cecil Scott,
